BookPage.aiTitle: Book from ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini
BookPage.aiText: My assistant also works inside AI chats. Add the address below as a custom connector, then just ask, for example: “Book an intro call with Huntay next week.” It shows my free times right in the chat and books the call for you.
BookPage.aiClaude: Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector
BookPage.aiChatgpt: ChatGPT: Settings → Apps → Developer mode → Create app
BookPage.aiGemini: Gemini: Settings → Connected Apps → Add a custom app
BookPage.aiNote: No sign-up or API key needed. Works with any MCP-compatible assistant.
